classified.text: Kintex Ultrascale+ FPGA shall support STANAG3350 / RGB / VGA, DVI, ARINC818 interfaces
PCIe interface: x8 PCIe interface on FPGA MGT bank; Reference clock from clock generator to FPGA MGT bank shall be used for PCIe.
DDR4/L SDRAM Interface: One 64 bit DDR4 SDRAM controller IP core shall be implemented in FPGA IO bank; Reference clock from clock generator to FPGA IO bank shall be used for DDR4 controller.
